name: std::random_device::operator()
intro: Generates a non-deterministic uniformly-distributed random value.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A random number uniformly distributed in [min(), max()].

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws an implementation-defined exception derived from std::exception if a random number could not be generated.
